patterns.name: 〜んじゃない
patterns.explanation: んじゃない after a verb is a rough 'don't do that'; ねえ is the tough-guy ない. The start of the verb is swallowed in the growl. ってんじゃねえ = 'don't be ...ing'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to warn someone. ねえぞ = 'don't, I'm warning you'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ってん is a slurred ている plus の: the い drops and る melts into ん. It says the action is going on. ってん = 'are ...ing'.
